clips.title: The story
paras: On an island in Brightwater Lake, Gunther Arcanus has escaped the Lich King's control and keeps apart from others. He believes every other undead remains a Scourge thrall.

During the Third War, the Scourge swept across the north and the Plague of Undeath killed Gunther, raising him into servitude. His arcane mastery and will let him break the Lich King's mental hold alone, without the weakening of the Lich King or Lady Sylvanas's help that others needed. Believing every other walking corpse remained a mindless Scourge thrall, Gunther withdrew to an island in Tirisfal Glades. Shambling guardians surround him, and he cuts off all contact with the living and the dead alike.
